varieties.name: Waltham
varieties.supplier_notes: The standard: classic pear shape, deep orange flesh, the variety exporters ask for.

timeline_template.description_en: Make mounds with well-rotted manure — butternut roots feed from the mound, not the path.
timeline_template.description_sw: Tengeneza matuta yenye samadi iliyooza — mizizi ya butternut inalisha kutoka tutani.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow 2 seeds per mound at 1.5m × 60cm; basal 50 kg DAP per acre in the mounds.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu 2 kwa tuta kwa 1.5m × 60cm; weka kilo 50 za DAP kwenye matuta.

timeline_template.description_en: Thin to the stronger seedling per mound; first weeding — weeds and vines tangle badly if left.
timeline_template.description_sw: Acha mche mmoja imara kwa tuta; palia kwanza.

timeline_template.description_en: Top-dress 50 kg CAN per acre at vining; keep paths clean as vines run.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za CAN wakati wa kutanua; weka njia safi.

timeline_template.description_en: The mildew watch: powdery mildew in warm-dry spells, downy in wet — scout weekly, treat at first dusting.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza ukungu kila wiki — unga joto-kavu, kijivu mvua — tibu mapema.

timeline_template.description_en: Protect young fruit from melon fly — stung fruit rots from inside. Bait sprays + remove fallen fruit.
timeline_template.description_sw: Linda matunda machanga dhidi ya nzi wa matunda — lililochomwa huoza ndani.

timeline_template.description_en: Cut when the stem cork-cracks and the skin is full tan with a hard rind. Leave 5 cm of stem.
timeline_template.description_sw: Vuna wakati shina limekauka na ngozi imekauka kabisa. Acha sentimita 5 za shina.
timeline_template.tip_en: Cure 10-14 days in dry airy shade — cured Waltham stores 3-6 months.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Kausha siku 10-14 kivulini — butternut iliyokaushwa hudumu miezi 3-6.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: 1-1.5 kg fruit is the export-supermarket sweet spot; oversized to bulk at a discount.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Loose in crates, 5 cm stem retained.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Cure 10-14 days in dry shade, then store — the one high-value crop where harvest and selling dates can be months apart.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Kausha siku 10-14 kivulini kisha hifadhi — zao pekee ambapo kuvuna na kuuza kunaweza kutenganishwa kwa miezi.

diseases.symptoms_en: White powder on leaves, yellowing, dieback in warm-dry spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Unga mweupe majani, kuwitikia, kufa kwa miti joto-kavu.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class or registered mildew products at first dusting. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa au zilizoidhinishwa mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Tolerant F1s, airflow, avoid water stress.
diseases.prevention_sw: F1 sugu, hewa, epuka mkazo wa maji.
diseases.scanner_notes: White powder on TOP of leaf, warm-dry weather.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellow patches above, grey-purple fuzz below, cool damp spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya manjano juu, ukungu wa kijivu chini, baridi na unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered downy-active fungicide at first patches. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya ukungu mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Airflow, morning watering, no overhead irrigation.
diseases.prevention_sw: Hewa, mwagilia asubuhi, usimwagilie kutoka juu.

diseases.symptoms_en: Pin-prick stings on young fruit, oozing, maggots inside, fruit rots from inside.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kuchomwa kwenye matunda machanga, viluwiluwi ndani, kuoza kutoka ndani.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered bait sprays + weekly fruit inspection; destroy stung fruit. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za chambo + chunguza matunda kila wiki; teketeza yaliyochomwa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Early fruit protection, sanitation, remove fallen fruit.
diseases.prevention_sw: Linda matunda mapema, usafi, ondoa yaliyoanguka.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the FRUIT surface and any cut-open fruit.

diseases.symptoms_en: Mottled distorted leaves, knobbly fruit, stunted vines; aphids present.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani yenye madoa yaliyopinda, matunda yenye uvimbe, miti dhaifu.
diseases.treatment_en: None — remove infected plants, early aphid control. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ondoa mimea iliyoathirika, dhibiti vidukari mapema. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Aphid management, clean seed, tolerant varieties.
diseases.prevention_sw: Dhibiti vidukari, mbegu safi, aina sugu.

diseases.symptoms_en: Sunken dark spots on ripening fruit, pink ooze in humidity.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meusi yaliyozama kwenye matunda yanayoiva, ute wa pinki.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered anthracnose-active sprays in wet spells. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa za anthracnose wakati wa mvua. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: No overhead watering, rotation, clean vines.
diseases.prevention_sw: Usimwagilie kutoka juu, zungusha, miti safi.
diseases.scanner_notes: Fruit photo needed; late-season + wet = diagnostic.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Cured butternut stores 3-6 months — the farmer's question is WHEN to sell, not whether. Prices firm in the dry season and ahead of export shipments.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Butternut iliyokaushwa hudumu miezi 3-6 — swali ni LINI kuuza, si kama. Bei hupanda kiangazi na kabla ya usafirishaji wa nje.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 30–60 KES per kg farm-gate by size grade (November 2026). Input bill 20,000–35,000 KES per acre.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 30–60 kwa kilo shambani kwa daraja la ukubwa (Novemba 2026). Gharama 20,000–35,000 KES kwa eka.
